issues: No independent protected holdout evaluation has been executed.

This is a development digital twin, not a released operational controller.
limitations: Development scenario PASS does not constitute MNCS-L5 PASS.

issues: The protected holdout and independent final evaluator are not yet instantiated.
Release authority and final candidate selection are not established.
limitations: The checked-in preregistration governs a development epoch only.
No D3 process claim is made by this record.

invalidation_triggers: Plant dynamics, pump characteristics, timestep, or metric accounting changes.
Any safety threshold, dwell rule, telemetry rule, or authority boundary changes.
A concrete EdgeStream adapter or telemetry envelope is selected for integration.
Holdout disclosure, evaluator change, threshold change, or candidate regeneration.

unresolved_unknowns: Independent water-utility and controls-engineering contract review.
Protected holdout outcome and evaluator independence.
Any future mapping to a real installation, PLC, SCADA system, or safety policy.

deviations.rationale: This commit establishes the executable development system and preregistered protocol before creating a protected evaluator.
deviations.risk: Repository-visible development results may overestimate generalization.

limitations: This assurance case intentionally records UNKNOWN rather than promoting development evidence to a formal claim.
The code cannot emit live industrial control traffic and must remain development-only.

revalidation_triggers: Any source, generated planner, contract, scenario, threshold, simulator, or checkpoint change.
Assignment of an independent evaluator or creation of a protected holdout.
Any proposal to connect the system to live equipment or industrial protocols.

retirement_triggers: A materially simpler implementation satisfies the same accepted requirements.

disposition.rationale: The development harness is executable and bounded, but formal implementation and process claims remain UNKNOWN.
